{'text': "I am testing the Dell 32-inch UltraSharp U3226Q and I'm very impressed so far. This OLED panel delivers outstanding picture quality, especially with HDR enabled in macOS. I will have a full review video of the UltraSharp on our YouTube channel. ", 'translation': '我正在測試 Dell 32 吋 UltraSharp U3226Q，至今為止印象極佳。呢塊 OLED 面板嘅畫質相當出色，尤其係喺 macOS 開啟咗 HDR 之後。我會喺我哋嘅 YouTube 頻道出一條 UltraSharp 嘅完整實測影片。 '}

{'text': 'But I wanted to highlight one important improvement Apple has made to HDR support in macOS 27. Previously, when using an HDR-capable third-party display with macOS 26 Tahoe, one drawback was that you could not enable HDR at a common scaled resolution like 2560 x 1440. Fortunately, this has been fixed in the new version of macOS. ', 'translation': '不過，我想特別提一提 Apple 喺 macOS 27 喺 HDR 支援方面作出嘅一項重要改進。之前用支援 HDR 嘅第三方顯示器搭配 macOS 26 Tahoe 嘅時候，有個缺點係冇辦法喺常見嘅 2560 x 1440 縮放解像度下啟用 HDR。好彩，新版本 macOS 已經解決咗呢個問題。 '}

{'text': 'The problem ', 'translation': '問題所在 '}

{'text': 'If you are using a third-party HDR10-capable display with macOS Tahoe, you will see a toggle for High Dynamic Range in Settings → Displays. When turned on, HDR content displays properly. You can see this in the screenshot below. ', 'translation': '如果你用緊支援 HDR10 嘅第三方顯示器配搭 macOS Tahoe，你會喺「設定 → 顯示器」入面見到一個高動態範圍嘅切換掣。開咗之後，HDR 內容就可以正常顯示。你可以喺下面嘅截圖入面睇到呢個效果。 '}

{'text': "But notice in the same screenshot that I am using a resolution of 1920 x 1080, which is a pixel-doubled resolution from the 4K UHD display's native 3840 x 2160. ", 'translation': '不過留意同一張截圖，你會見到我而家用緊嘅係 1920 x 1080 解像度，即係呢部 4K UHD 顯示器原生 3840 x 2160 解像度嘅兩倍 pixel-doubled 解像度。 '}

{'text': "Most users wouldn't want to run at 1920 x 1080 because content appears way too large on a 4K display. The Dell UltraSharp U3226Q is a 32-inch display, so the usable screen real estate at 1920 x 1080 is drastically reduced. ", 'translation': '大部分用戶應該都唔想用 1920 x 1080 嚟跑，因為喺 4K 顯示器上面會令到內容睇落太大。Dell UltraSharp U3226Q 係一部 32 吋嘅顯示器，用 1920×1080 嘅話可用嘅畫面空間會大幅縮減。 '}

{'text': "The solution in macOS is simple: choose a scaled resolution, such as the popular 2560 x 1440 option — which is also the default on Apple's 5K Studio Display. The problem is that when you choose a scaled resolution in macOS Tahoe, HDR is disabled. See the screenshot below: ", 'translation': '要喺 macOS 入面解決呢個問題好簡單：揀返一個縮放解像度就得，例如好多人用嘅 2560 x 1440，呢個亦係 Apple 5K Studio Display 嘅預設設定。問題係，當你喺 macOS Tahoe 入面揀咗縮放解像度，HDR 就會被關閉。睇下下面嗰張截圖就知： '}

{'text': 'As you can see, the High Dynamic Range toggle is gone, and macOS automatically falls back to Standard Dynamic Range. In other words, with macOS Tahoe and an HDR display, you can either have HDR or a common scaled resolution — but not both. ', 'translation': '正如你所見，高動態範圍嘅切換掣已經唔再出現，macOS 會自動切返去標準動態範圍。換言之，用 macOS Tahoe 配 HDR 顯示器嘅話，你只能喺 HDR 同常用嘅縮放解像度之間二揀一。 '}

{'text': 'Fortunately, this has been fixed in macOS 27 Golden Gate. As you can see in the screenshot below, a scaled resolution and HDR can be enabled at the same time. This is a system-level feature, without any third-party software. ', 'translation': '好彩，macOS 27 Golden Gate 已經修正咗呢個問題。喺下面嘅截圖入面可以見到，縮放解像度同 HDR 可以同時開住用。呢個係系統原生功能，唔涉及任何第三方軟件。 '}

{'text': "So if you're using a third-party HDR display, that alone is worth the upgrade from macOS Tahoe to macOS Golden Gate, in my opinion. Of course, I am currently testing this on my M4 MacBook Pro. I tried the same thing on my M1 Max MacBook Pro and was unable to enable both settings, even with macOS 27 installed, so there appears to be a hardware requirement as well. ", 'translation': '所以如果你用緊第三方 HDR 顯示器，淨係呢一點，我認為已經值得由 macOS Tahoe 升級去 macOS Golden Gate。當然，我而家測試緊嘅係我部 M4 MacBook Pro。我喺 M1 Max MacBook Pro 上面都試過同樣嘅嘢，但即使裝咗 macOS 27，都冇辦法同時揀到呢兩個設定，所以睇嚟都有硬件上嘅要求。 '}

{'text': "macOS Golden Gate includes a slew of new features, which I've covered in the Siri AI overview, the macOS highlights video, and the final review of macOS 27. Among them is more comprehensive native HDR support across the system in macOS 27. ", 'translation': 'macOS Golden Gate 加入咗一系列新功能，我之前喺 Siri AI 概覽、macOS 重點功能影片，以及 macOS 27 嘅最終評測入面都有介紹過。當中同 HDR 顯示器有關嘅一項，就係 macOS 27 喺成個系統層面提供更全面嘅原生 HDR 支援。 '}

{'text': "You'll notice brighter specular highlights, brighter cursors, and overall better contrast compared to macOS Tahoe. The visual experience is excellent for Apple Studio Display XDR users, Pro Display XDR users, and third-party OLED display users alike. ", 'translation': '你會留意到比 macOS Tahoe 更光嘅光譜高光、游標，以及整體對比度更高嘅畫面。對 Apple Studio Display XDR 用戶、Pro Display XDR 用戶以至第三方 OLED 顯示器用戶嚟講，視覺效果都相當出色。 '}

{'text': 'What are your thoughts? Are you using a third-party external display with your Mac? If so, would you consider switching to an HDR-capable model? ', 'translation': '你有咩睇法？你有冇用第三方外置顯示器配 Mac？如果有，你會唔會考慮轉用支援 HDR 嘅型號？ '}
